label: Keyword Alert
description: Watches the room for a keyword and posts a brief alert when it appears.

slots.name: keyword
slots.question: What word or phrase should the bot watch for?
slots.hint: Interpreted as a regular expression. Use simple words unless you need pattern matching.

constraints: The keyword is treated as a regular expression, so regex metacharacters (., *, +, ?, etc.) have special meaning.
The bot posts in the room where it is installed. It does not direct-message the invoker.
